highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.4 expands native platform support and resolves rendering, lifetime, and platform integration failures.
highlights_body: It adds GTK4 and Linux Bionic support, broadens Tizen and .NET Framework coverage, and rolls up the 3.119.3 preview fixes.

breaking.title: Blazor integration changes
breaking.body: The Blazor view package includes API changes in this release. Review the generated API diff and update affected view integration code before upgrading.

bullets.lead: Desktop and mobile rendering reliability improved
bullets.detail: Fixes address GTK4 Cairo assertion failures, Android MAUI SKGLView rendering after tab switches, and tvOS device and simulator native assets.
SKManagedStream now retains an SKData snapshot rather than relying on a parent-child ownership chain.

bullets.lead: GTK4, Linux Bionic, Tizen, and .NET Framework support expanded
bullets.detail: Adds the GTK4 view package and Linux Bionic assets, builds Tizen for x64 and arm64, and adds a net48 target for Windows validation.
D3D12 is delay-loaded to avoid startup failures on systems without DirectX 12, and the Linux linker now rejects unresolved native symbols.
Updates libpng and includes the native hardening work first delivered in the 3.119.3 preview.

contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Added Linux Bionic native assets and legacy target support
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed Android MAUI SKGLView rendering after tab switches

preview_summaries.v3.119.3-preview.1.1: The carried-forward preview added AOT and Linux ARM64 reliability fixes with native package hardening.
preview_summaries.v3.119.4-preview.1.1: Preview 1 added GTK4, Linux Bionic, Tizen, and desktop reliability improvements.

harfbuzz_summary: Includes the HarfBuzzSharp binding and native dependency updates carried forward from the 3.119.3 preview.
